title: Zesty Crisp Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A jammy and crisp weeknight Uruguayan dish featuring kanten agar and kombu cold extract, this recipe is perfect for a quick and flavorful meal. The combination of beef, kanten agar, and spices creates a unique and delicious taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together kanten agar, kombu cold extract, olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef strips to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the beef strips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15 minutes.
Brush the skewers with lemon juice and continue baking for an additional 5 minutes, or until crispy and cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the oven and garnish with chopped parsley if desired.
Serve the skewers hot and enjoy.
